# OPTestResultBoot {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
OPTestResultBoot
```
Result of the bootstrap ordinal-pattern test [`test_op_bootstrap`](test_op_bootstrap.qmd).
 
Fields:
 
  * `chart`: the chart choice the test was computed for.
  * `stat::Float64`: value of the test statistic.
  * `boot_crit::Float64`: bootstrap critical value.
  * `boot_pval::Float64`: bootstrap p-value.
  * `boot_reject::Bool`: whether the null hypothesis is rejected at the chosen level.
  * `n_boot::Int`: number of bootstrap replications.
  * `boot_dist::Vector{Float64}`: the `n_boot` resampled statistics, i.e. the bootstrap null distribution the critical value and the p-value were computed from.
With Makie loaded, `plot(res)` draws a histogram of `boot_dist` with the rejection region, the critical value and the observed statistic; see the plotting tutorial in the docs.
 


:::
